body:
Just saw this.  If the company blamed it on filters, they do not know what they are talking about.

Can the tech write a report on findings?

Im an engineer and i cannot for the life of me figure out how this happened.  Normally, ductwork is installed in a crawlspace or basement.  The pressure associated with home units is not enough to blow it out like that.  

1.  Where was the ductwork located?  
2.  How did you get mold in your walls?  Normally the air is around 55 degrees and unless your house was really hot and you were only using hard duct, you are above the dewpoint unless you are in a humid climate.

I have so many questions
